title: MoPrO-SD: Modular Prompt Optimization for Stance Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.13386v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stance detection remains challenging for large language models (LLMs) due to implicit opinions, sarcasm, and context-dependent expressions of stance. Although automatic prompt optimization offers an alternative to fine-tuning without updating model parameters, existing structured approaches are not specifically designed around stance-label semantics and class-specific ambiguities. We introduce MoPrO-SD, a stance-specific prompt optimization framework that decomposes prompts into functional semantic modules and refines them sequentially using LLM-based feedback. We study three refinement strategies: instruction-only optimization (I), instruction with reasoning (I+R), and instruction with per-example reasoning (I+R+E), using class-conditioned errors for stance-label refinement. translated_title: MoPrO-SD：面向立场检测的模块化提示优化
translated_abstract: 立场检测对大型语言模型（LLM）而言仍然具有挑战性，原因在于隐含观点、讽刺表达以及依赖语境的立场表述。尽管自动提示优化提供了一种无需更新模型参数的微调替代方案，但现有的结构化方法并非专门围绕立场标签语义和类别特定的歧义而设计。我们提出了MoPrO-SD，这是一个针对立场检测的提示优化框架，它将提示分解为功能性语义模块，并利用基于LLM的反馈对其进行顺序优化。我们研究了三种优化策略：仅指令优化（I）、带推理的指令优化（I+R）以及带逐样本推理的指令优化（I+R+E），并使用类别条件错误来进行立场标签的优化。我们还引入了VaccineStance，这是一个新的人工标注的疫苗立场检测基准。在四个数据集和五个开源权重LLM上进行的实验表明……
tldr: 提出面向立场检测的模块化提示优化框架MoPrO-SD，将提示分解为功能性语义模块并利用LLM反馈进行顺序优化，同时发布人工标注的疫苗立场检测基准VaccineStance。
en_tdlr: MoPrO-SD is a stance-specific prompt optimization framework that decomposes prompts into functional semantic modules and sequentially refines them using LLM-based feedback, accompanied by a new human-annotated vaccine stance detection benchmark called VaccineStance.
